description: Search Camptocamp.org areas by name (titles match in any language, fuzzily — check the returned titles; towns are not areas, search the range or département instead). area_type: range = mountain range/massif; admin_limits = administrative subdivision such as a French département or Swiss canton; country = country. Returns ID, title and type, after a header giving the total, the offset and the filters. Pass the returned ID as area_id to search_routes, search_waypoints and search_outings. Use offset to page (offset + limit ≤ 10,000): the output ends with 'Next page: offset=N' when more results follow — or 'Next page: offset=N (limit at most M)' near the window's end, where limit must be lowered to M — or says when they lie beyond Camptocamp's 10,000-result window. lang (default fr) picks the language of titles and texts; when a document has no text in it, the first available of fr, en, it, de, es, ca, eu, sl, zh is used. Labels and codes stay in English.

area_type.description: Restrict to one area type: range, admin_limits or country

lang.description: Language of titles and texts, one of: fr, en, de, it, es, ca, eu, sl, zh (default fr)

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging (offset + limit ≤ 10,000)

name: search_areas
title: Search areas
